topics.title: Present Perfect
topics.explanation: We use "have/has + past participle" for past actions with a connection to now, or when the exact time isn't important.
topics.explanationAr: نستخدم "have/has + التصريف الثالث" لأفعال ماضية لها صلة بالحاضر، أو عندما لا يكون الوقت الدقيق مهما.

examples.en: I have finished my homework.
She has visited Paris.
We have seen this movie.
Have you ever tried sushi?

topics.title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
topics.explanation: Use Past Simple for a finished time (yesterday, last week). Use Present Perfect when the time isn't stated or still connects to now.
topics.explanationAr: استخدم الماضي البسيط لوقت منتهٍ (أمس، الأسبوع الماضي). استخدم المضارع التام عندما لا يُذكر الوقت أو لا يزال متصلا بالحاضر.

examples.en: I visited London in 2019.
I have visited London.
She lost her keys yesterday.
She has lost her keys.

topics.title: Present Perfect with For and Since
topics.titleAr: المضارع التام مع for و since
topics.explanation: "For" is used with a period of time (for two years). "Since" is used with a starting point (since 2020).
topics.explanationAr: "For" تُستخدم مع فترة زمنية (for two years). "Since" تُستخدم مع نقطة بداية (since 2020).

examples.en: I have lived here for five years.
She has known him since 2018.
We have studied English for two years.
He has been sick since Monday.

topics.title: First Conditional
topics.explanation: "If + present simple, will + base verb" describes a real, possible situation and its likely result.
topics.explanationAr: "If + مضارع بسيط، will + فعل أساسي" تصف موقفا حقيقيا وممكنا ونتيجته المحتملة.

examples.en: If it rains, I will stay home.
If you study, you will pass the test.
If she calls, I will answer.
We will be late if we don't hurry.

topics.title: Second Conditional
topics.explanation: "If + past simple, would + base verb" describes an unreal or unlikely situation and its imagined result.
topics.explanationAr: "If + ماضٍ بسيط، would + فعل أساسي" تصف موقفا غير حقيقي أو غير محتمل ونتيجته المتخيلة.

examples.en: If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world.
examples.ar: لو كان لدي مليون دولار، لسافرت حول العالم.

examples.en: If I were you, I would apologize.
She would be happier if she had a pet.
examples.ar: ستكون أسعد لو كان لديها حيوان أليف.

examples.en: What would you do if you won the lottery?

topics.title: Used to
topics.explanation: "Used to + base verb" describes a past habit or state that is no longer true.
topics.explanationAr: "used to + فعل أساسي" تصف عادة أو حالة ماضية لم تعد صحيحة.

examples.en: I used to be afraid of the dark.
examples.ar: كنت أخاف من الظلام في الماضي.

examples.en: She used to live in Cairo.
We used to play together every day.
Did you use to like vegetables?

topics.title: Question Tags
topics.explanation: A short question added to the end of a statement, to check or confirm information.
topics.explanationAr: سؤال قصير يُضاف إلى نهاية جملة، للتحقق من معلومة أو تأكيدها.

examples.en: You like pizza, don't you?
She isn't here, is she?
It's cold today, isn't it?
You can swim, can't you?

topics.title: Too / Enough
topics.explanation: "Too" (before an adjective) means more than needed, in a negative way. "Enough" (after an adjective) means the right amount.
topics.explanationAr: "Too" (قبل الصفة) تعني أكثر من اللازم، بشكل سلبي. "Enough" (بعد الصفة) تعني الكمية المناسبة.

examples.en: This box is too heavy for me.
examples.ar: هذا الصندوق ثقيل جدا بالنسبة لي.

examples.en: Is the water warm enough?
She is too tired to play.
I don't have enough money.
examples.ar: ليس لدي ما يكفي من المال.
